## Sinusoidal Baseline and Plague-Related Excess Mortality

To estimate how many deaths during the primary outbreak were attributable to plague, we first fit an annual sinusoidal baseline to all observations before September 1, 1630. The harmonic regression below is equivalent to fitting a sinusoid with an estimated mean, amplitude, and phase:

$$
B(t) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \sin(2\pi t / 365.2425) +
       \beta_2 \cos(2\pi t / 365.2425).
$$

We then extrapolate this non-plague baseline through December 31, 1630 and subtract it from the observed daily mortality. Negative daily differences are retained in the signed estimate for diagnostic purposes, but are set to zero in the estimate of plague-related deaths because they do not represent negative plague cases.

```{r fit sinusoidal pre-plague baseline}
outbreak_start <- as.Date("1630-09-01")
outbreak_end <- as.Date("1630-12-31")
annual_period <- 365.2425

# Aggregate the parish-level mortality counts to a citywide daily count.
baseline_daily <- data.frame(
  Date = filled$Date,
  observed_deaths = rowSums(filled[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
)
baseline_daily$day_index <- as.numeric(
  baseline_daily$Date - min(baseline_daily$Date)
)
baseline_daily$sin_annual <- sin(
  2 * pi * baseline_daily$day_index / annual_period
)
baseline_daily$cos_annual <- cos(
  2 * pi * baseline_daily$day_index / annual_period
)

pre_plague_daily <- baseline_daily[
  baseline_daily$Date < outbreak_start,
]

sinusoidal_baseline_model <- lm(
  observed_deaths ~ sin_annual + cos_annual,
  data = pre_plague_daily
)

# Baseline fitted values are constrained to be nonnegative because mortality counts cannot be negative.
baseline_daily$expected_baseline_deaths <- pmax(
  predict(sinusoidal_baseline_model, newdata = baseline_daily),
  0
)

outbreak_excess <- baseline_daily[
  baseline_daily$Date >= outbreak_start &
    baseline_daily$Date <= outbreak_end,
]
outbreak_excess$signed_excess_deaths <-
  outbreak_excess$observed_deaths -
  outbreak_excess$expected_baseline_deaths
outbreak_excess$estimated_plague_deaths <- pmax(
  outbreak_excess$signed_excess_deaths,
  0
)

baseline_model_summary <- summary(sinusoidal_baseline_model)
baseline_amplitude <- sqrt(sum(
  coef(sinusoidal_baseline_model)[c("sin_annual", "cos_annual")]^2
))

plague_excess_summary <- data.frame(
  outbreak_start = outbreak_start,
  outbreak_end = outbreak_end,
  observed_deaths = sum(outbreak_excess$observed_deaths),
  expected_baseline_deaths = sum(
    outbreak_excess$expected_baseline_deaths
  ),
  signed_excess_deaths = sum(outbreak_excess$signed_excess_deaths),
  estimated_plague_deaths = sum(
    outbreak_excess$estimated_plague_deaths
  )
)
plague_excess_summary$estimated_plague_fraction <-
  plague_excess_summary$estimated_plague_deaths /
  plague_excess_summary$observed_deaths

print(baseline_model_summary)
print(paste("Estimated seasonal amplitude:", round(baseline_amplitude, 2)))
print(plague_excess_summary)
```

The signed excess is the difference between total observed and expected deaths over the entire window. The nonnegative estimate, `estimated_plague_deaths`, is the sum of daily excess deaths after truncating negative daily differences at zero and is the primary estimate of plague-related mortality.

```{r plot sinusoidal baseline and excess mortality, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
baseline_plot_data <- baseline_daily[
  baseline_daily$Date <= outbreak_end,
]

baseline_plot <- ggplot(
  baseline_plot_data,
  aes(x = Date, y = observed_deaths)
) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = outbreak_start,
    xmax = outbreak_end,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "firebrick",
    alpha = 0.08
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = expected_baseline_deaths),
    color = "steelblue",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Daily deaths",
    title = "Observed Mortality and Pre-Plague Sinusoidal Baseline",
    subtitle = "Blue: baseline fitted before September 1, 1630; shaded: primary outbreak"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

excess_plot <- ggplot(
  outbreak_excess,
  aes(x = Date, y = estimated_plague_deaths)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick", width = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Estimated plague-related deaths",
    title = "Daily Mortality Above the Sinusoidal Baseline"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

plot_grid(
  baseline_plot,
  excess_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  labels = c("a", "b"),
  align = "v"
)
```

## Spatial Clustering Before vs. During the Primary Outbreak

The all-cause mortality data may include deaths from the concurrent smallpox
outbreak, particularly before the primary plague wave. We therefore compare
the spatial pattern of mortality in the pre-outbreak period (January 1, 1629
through August 31, 1630) with the primary outbreak period (September 1 through
December 31, 1630). Period-specific mortality is expressed as deaths per 1,000
person-days so that the unequal lengths of the two periods do not affect the
reported rates.

The 1729 parish polygons utilized in the choropleth map generation are used as an
approximation to the 1630 parish boundaries. Because the parishes were separated by
canals, we define geographic proximity using a symmetric four-nearest-neighbor
graph based on projected parish centroids. Analyses using three, five, and eight
nearest neighbors assess sensitivity to this choice of spatial scale.

```{r prepare spatial clustering data, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
spatial_pre_start <- as.Date("1629-01-01")
spatial_pre_end <- as.Date("1630-08-31")
spatial_outbreak_start <- as.Date("1630-09-01")
spatial_outbreak_end <- as.Date("1630-12-31")
spatial_permutations <- 9999L
spatial_seed <- 1630L
spatial_annual_period <- 365.2425

normalize_spatial_parish <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[[:space:]]", ".", x)
  x <- sub("^S\\.\\.", "S.", x)
  x[grepl("^S\\.Mois", x)] <- "S.Moise"
  x[grepl("^S\\.Tom", x)] <- "S.Toma"
  x[grepl("^S\\.Giacomo\\.dell", x)] <- "S.Giacomo.dell.Orio"
  x[x == "S.Angelo.Rafael"] <- "Angelo.Rafael"
  x
}

# Re-read with check.names = FALSE so accented parish names are not dropped by
# locale-dependent name conversion in the notebook's earlier cleaning steps.
spatial_filled <- read.csv(
  "filledna_full_ts.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)
colnames(spatial_filled)[1] <- "Date"
spatial_filled$Date <- as.Date(spatial_filled$Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
colnames(spatial_filled)[-1] <- normalize_spatial_parish(
  colnames(spatial_filled)[-1]
)
spatial_filled[, -1] <- lapply(
  spatial_filled[, -1, drop = FALSE],
  function(x) {
    x <- as.numeric(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- 0
    x
  }
)

spatial_excluded_parishes <- c(
  "S.Marcilian",
  "S.Polo",
  "S.Stae",
  "S.Marco"
)
spatial_filled <- spatial_filled[
  , !(colnames(spatial_filled) %in% spatial_excluded_parishes)
]

analysis_parishes <- colnames(spatial_filled)[-1]
analysis_parishes_normalized <- normalize_spatial_parish(analysis_parishes)

stopifnot(
  length(analysis_parishes) == 50L,
  !anyDuplicated(analysis_parishes_normalized)
)

population_names_normalized <- normalize_spatial_parish(
  population$Parish
)
population_match <- match(
  analysis_parishes_normalized,
  population_names_normalized
)
stopifnot(!anyNA(population_match))

spatial_population <-
  population$Population[population_match] * 1000
stopifnot(all(is.finite(spatial_population)), all(spatial_population > 0))

pre_period_index <-
  spatial_filled$Date >= spatial_pre_start &
  spatial_filled$Date <= spatial_pre_end
outbreak_period_index <-
  spatial_filled$Date >= spatial_outbreak_start &
  spatial_filled$Date <= spatial_outbreak_end

pre_period_days <- sum(pre_period_index)
outbreak_period_days <- sum(outbreak_period_index)
stopifnot(pre_period_days == 608L, outbreak_period_days == 122L)

pre_period_deaths <- colSums(
  spatial_filled[pre_period_index, -1, drop = FALSE]
)
outbreak_period_deaths <- colSums(
  spatial_filled[outbreak_period_index, -1, drop = FALSE]
)

# Fit the same annual harmonic form used in the preceding citywide baseline
# analysis separately for each parish. Predictions below zero are truncated
# before expected deaths are summed over the outbreak period.
spatial_day_index <- as.numeric(
  spatial_filled$Date - min(spatial_filled$Date)
)
spatial_harmonic_data <- data.frame(
  sin_annual = sin(2 * pi * spatial_day_index / spatial_annual_period),
  cos_annual = cos(2 * pi * spatial_day_index / spatial_annual_period)
)

expected_outbreak_deaths <- rep(NA_real_, length(analysis_parishes))
for (j in seq_along(analysis_parishes)) {
  parish_harmonic_data <- spatial_harmonic_data
  parish_harmonic_data$deaths <- spatial_filled[[analysis_parishes[j]]]

  parish_baseline_model <- lm(
    deaths ~ sin_annual + cos_annual,
    data = parish_harmonic_data[pre_period_index, ]
  )
  parish_expected_daily <- predict(
    parish_baseline_model,
    newdata = parish_harmonic_data[outbreak_period_index, ]
  )

  if (any(!is.finite(parish_expected_daily))) {
    parish_expected_daily <- rep(
      mean(parish_harmonic_data$deaths[pre_period_index]),
      outbreak_period_days
    )
  }

  expected_outbreak_deaths[j] <- sum(pmax(parish_expected_daily, 0))
}

excess_outbreak_deaths <- pmax(
  outbreak_period_deaths - expected_outbreak_deaths,
  0
)

spatial_period_values <- data.frame(
  Parish = analysis_parishes_normalized,
  Population_1629 = spatial_population,
  Pre_outbreak_deaths = as.numeric(pre_period_deaths),
  Outbreak_deaths = as.numeric(outbreak_period_deaths),
  Expected_baseline_deaths = expected_outbreak_deaths,
  Excess_outbreak_deaths = excess_outbreak_deaths
)
spatial_period_values$Pre_outbreak_rate <-
  spatial_period_values$Pre_outbreak_deaths /
  (spatial_period_values$Population_1629 * pre_period_days) * 1000
spatial_period_values$Outbreak_rate <-
  spatial_period_values$Outbreak_deaths /
  (spatial_period_values$Population_1629 * outbreak_period_days) * 1000
spatial_period_values$Excess_outbreak_rate <-
  spatial_period_values$Excess_outbreak_deaths /
  (spatial_period_values$Population_1629 * outbreak_period_days) * 1000

spatial_shape_all <- st_read(
  "1729_PAR_CONF.zip.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)
spatial_shape_all$Parish <- normalize_spatial_parish(spatial_shape_all$NAME)
spatial_shape_all <- st_make_valid(spatial_shape_all)

# Dissolve duplicate parish features, including the two S. Leonardo polygons.
spatial_shape_all <- aggregate(
  spatial_shape_all["Parish"],
  by = list(Parish = spatial_shape_all$Parish),
  FUN = function(x) x[1]
)
spatial_shape_crs <- st_crs(spatial_shape_all)
spatial_shape_all <- st_transform(spatial_shape_all, 32633)
spatial_shape_all <- suppressWarnings(st_buffer(spatial_shape_all, 0))
spatial_shape_all <- st_transform(spatial_shape_all, spatial_shape_crs)

shape_match <- match(
  analysis_parishes_normalized,
  spatial_shape_all$Parish
)
stopifnot(!anyNA(shape_match))

spatial_shape <- spatial_shape_all[shape_match, ]
spatial_shape$Parish <- analysis_parishes_normalized
stopifnot(
  nrow(spatial_shape) == 50L,
  !anyDuplicated(spatial_shape$Parish),
  all(st_is_valid(spatial_shape)),
  !any(st_is_empty(spatial_shape))
)

spatial_shape <- merge(
  spatial_shape,
  spatial_period_values,
  by = "Parish",
  sort = FALSE
)
spatial_shape <- spatial_shape[
  match(analysis_parishes_normalized, spatial_shape$Parish),
]

literal_contiguity_neighbors <- st_touches(spatial_shape)
literal_contiguity_isolates <- sum(lengths(literal_contiguity_neighbors) == 0L)
stopifnot(literal_contiguity_isolates == nrow(spatial_shape))
print(paste(
  "Parishes isolated under literal polygon contiguity:",
  literal_contiguity_isolates,
  "of",
  nrow(spatial_shape)
))

spatial_centroids <- st_centroid(
  st_geometry(st_transform(spatial_shape, 32633))
)
spatial_distance_matrix <- as.matrix(st_distance(spatial_centroids))
spatial_distance_matrix <- units::drop_units(spatial_distance_matrix)
diag(spatial_distance_matrix) <- Inf
```

```{r define spatial clustering functions}
make_symmetric_knn_weights <- function(distance_matrix, k) {
  n <- nrow(distance_matrix)
  directed_adjacency <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    directed_adjacency[i, order(distance_matrix[i, ])[seq_len(k)]] <- 1
  }

  adjacency <- 1 * ((directed_adjacency + t(directed_adjacency)) > 0)
  weights <- adjacency / rowSums(adjacency)

  stopifnot(
    all(adjacency == t(adjacency)),
    all(rowSums(adjacency) > 0),
    max(abs(rowSums(weights) - 1)) < 1e-12
  )

  list(adjacency = adjacency, weights = weights)
}

global_moran_i <- function(x, weights) {
  centered_x <- x - mean(x)
  n <- length(centered_x)
  s0 <- sum(weights)

  (n / s0) *
    sum(weights * (centered_x %o% centered_x)) /
    sum(centered_x^2)
}

permutation_global_moran <- function(
  x,
  weights,
  permutations = 9999L,
  seed = 1630L
) {
  observed <- global_moran_i(x, weights)
  expected <- -1 / (length(x) - 1)

  set.seed(seed)
  simulated <- replicate(
    permutations,
    global_moran_i(sample(x, replace = FALSE), weights)
  )

  data.frame(
    Moran_I = observed,
    Expected_I = expected,
    Permutation_p =
      (1 + sum(abs(simulated - expected) >= abs(observed - expected))) /
      (permutations + 1),
    Null_2.5_percentile = unname(quantile(simulated, 0.025)),
    Null_97.5_percentile = unname(quantile(simulated, 0.975))
  )
}

paired_moran_difference_test <- function(
  x_pre,
  x_outbreak,
  weights,
  permutations = 9999L,
  seed = 1630L
) {
  pre_z <- as.numeric(scale(x_pre))
  outbreak_z <- as.numeric(scale(x_outbreak))
  observed_difference <-
    global_moran_i(outbreak_z, weights) -
    global_moran_i(pre_z, weights)

  set.seed(seed)
  simulated_difference <- replicate(permutations, {
    swap_period <- runif(length(pre_z)) < 0.5
    permuted_pre <- pre_z
    permuted_outbreak <- outbreak_z
    permuted_pre[swap_period] <- outbreak_z[swap_period]
    permuted_outbreak[swap_period] <- pre_z[swap_period]

    global_moran_i(permuted_outbreak, weights) -
      global_moran_i(permuted_pre, weights)
  })

  data.frame(
    Moran_difference = observed_difference,
    Paired_permutation_p =
      (1 + sum(abs(simulated_difference) >= abs(observed_difference))) /
      (permutations + 1),
    Null_2.5_percentile = unname(quantile(simulated_difference, 0.025)),
    Null_97.5_percentile = unname(quantile(simulated_difference, 0.975))
  )
}

conditional_local_moran <- function(
  x,
  weights,
  permutations = 9999L,
  seed = 1630L
) {
  z <- as.numeric(scale(x))
  spatial_lag <- as.numeric(weights %*% z)
  m2 <- sum(z^2) / length(z)
  observed_local_i <- z * spatial_lag / m2
  permutation_p <- rep(NA_real_, length(z))

  for (i in seq_along(z)) {
    neighbor_index <- which(weights[i, ] > 0)
    neighbor_weights <- weights[i, neighbor_index]
    candidate_values <- z[-i]

    set.seed(seed + i)
    simulated_local_i <- replicate(permutations, {
      sampled_values <- sample(
        candidate_values,
        length(neighbor_index),
        replace = FALSE
      )
      z[i] * sum(neighbor_weights * sampled_values) / m2
    })
    simulated_center <- mean(simulated_local_i)
    permutation_p[i] <-
      (1 + sum(
        abs(simulated_local_i - simulated_center) >=
          abs(observed_local_i[i] - simulated_center)
      )) / (permutations + 1)
  }

  adjusted_p <- p.adjust(permutation_p, method = "BH")
  cluster <- ifelse(
    z >= 0 & spatial_lag >= 0,
    "High-high",
    ifelse(
      z < 0 & spatial_lag < 0,
      "Low-low",
      ifelse(z >= 0, "High-low", "Low-high")
    )
  )
  cluster[adjusted_p >= 0.05] <- "Not significant"

  data.frame(
    Local_Moran_I = observed_local_i,
    Standardized_rate = z,
    Spatial_lag = spatial_lag,
    Permutation_p = permutation_p,
    Adjusted_p = adjusted_p,
    Cluster = factor(
      cluster,
      levels = c(
        "High-high",
        "Low-low",
        "High-low",
        "Low-high",
        "Not significant"
      )
    )
  )
}
```

```{r calculate global and local spatial clustering results}
spatial_rate_vectors <- list(
  "Pre-outbreak" = spatial_shape$Pre_outbreak_rate,
  "Observed outbreak" = spatial_shape$Outbreak_rate,
  "Baseline-adjusted outbreak" = spatial_shape$Excess_outbreak_rate
)
spatial_period_days <- c(
  "Pre-outbreak" = pre_period_days,
  "Observed outbreak" = outbreak_period_days,
  "Baseline-adjusted outbreak" = outbreak_period_days
)
spatial_period_death_totals <- c(
  "Pre-outbreak" = sum(spatial_shape$Pre_outbreak_deaths),
  "Observed outbreak" = sum(spatial_shape$Outbreak_deaths),
  "Baseline-adjusted outbreak" = sum(spatial_shape$Excess_outbreak_deaths)
)

primary_knn <- make_symmetric_knn_weights(spatial_distance_matrix, 4L)
primary_spatial_weights <- primary_knn$weights

spatial_global_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  names(spatial_rate_vectors),
  function(period_name) {
    result <- permutation_global_moran(
      spatial_rate_vectors[[period_name]],
      primary_spatial_weights,
      permutations = spatial_permutations,
      seed = spatial_seed
    )
    data.frame(
      Period = period_name,
      Days = unname(spatial_period_days[period_name]),
      Deaths = unname(spatial_period_death_totals[period_name]),
      result,
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }
))

spatial_moran_difference <- paired_moran_difference_test(
  spatial_shape$Pre_outbreak_rate,
  spatial_shape$Outbreak_rate,
  primary_spatial_weights,
  permutations = spatial_permutations,
  seed = spatial_seed
)

spatial_pattern_similarity <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c(
    "Pre-outbreak vs. observed outbreak",
    "Observed vs. baseline-adjusted outbreak"
  ),
  Spearman_rho = c(
    cor(
      spatial_shape$Pre_outbreak_rate,
      spatial_shape$Outbreak_rate,
      method = "spearman"
    ),
    cor(
      spatial_shape$Outbreak_rate,
      spatial_shape$Excess_outbreak_rate,
      method = "spearman"
    )
  )
)

spatial_weight_sensitivity <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  c(3L, 4L, 5L, 8L),
  function(k) {
    knn <- make_symmetric_knn_weights(spatial_distance_matrix, k)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(spatial_rate_vectors), function(period_name) {
      result <- permutation_global_moran(
        spatial_rate_vectors[[period_name]],
        knn$weights,
        permutations = spatial_permutations,
        seed = spatial_seed
      )
      data.frame(
        Neighbors = k,
        Period = period_name,
        Minimum_degree = min(rowSums(knn$adjacency)),
        Maximum_degree = max(rowSums(knn$adjacency)),
        result,
        row.names = NULL
      )
    }))
  }
))

spatial_local_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  names(spatial_rate_vectors),
  function(period_name) {
    result <- conditional_local_moran(
      spatial_rate_vectors[[period_name]],
      primary_spatial_weights,
      permutations = spatial_permutations,
      seed = spatial_seed
    )
    data.frame(
      Parish = spatial_shape$Parish,
      Period = period_name,
      result,
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }
))

print(spatial_global_results)
print(spatial_moran_difference)
print(spatial_pattern_similarity)
print(spatial_weight_sensitivity)
print(subset(
  spatial_local_results,
  Cluster != "Not significant",
  select = c(Parish, Period, Local_Moran_I, Adjusted_p, Cluster)
))
```

Under the primary four-nearest-neighbor definition, pre-outbreak mortality had
Moran's $I$ = `r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_global_results$Moran_I[spatial_global_results$Period == "Pre-outbreak"])`
($p$ = `r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_global_results$Permutation_p[spatial_global_results$Period == "Pre-outbreak"])`),
whereas observed outbreak mortality had Moran's $I$ =
`r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_global_results$Moran_I[spatial_global_results$Period == "Observed outbreak"])`
($p$ = `r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_global_results$Permutation_p[spatial_global_results$Period == "Observed outbreak"])`).
The direct paired difference in Moran's $I$ was
`r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_moran_difference$Moran_difference)`
($p$ = `r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_moran_difference$Paired_permutation_p)`),
so the data do not establish a statistically clear difference in global
clustering strength between periods. Evidence of outbreak clustering also
depends on the neighborhood scale, as shown in the sensitivity table.

After subtracting each parish's sinusoidal baseline, the outbreak pattern had
Moran's $I$ =
`r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_global_results$Moran_I[spatial_global_results$Period == "Baseline-adjusted outbreak"])`
($p$ = `r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_global_results$Permutation_p[spatial_global_results$Period == "Baseline-adjusted outbreak"])`).
The observed and baseline-adjusted outbreak rates were very similarly ranked
across parishes (Spearman $\rho$ =
`r sprintf("%.3f", spatial_pattern_similarity$Spearman_rho[spatial_pattern_similarity$Comparison == "Observed vs. baseline-adjusted outbreak"])`).
Thus, subtracting modeled non-plague baseline mortality does not materially
alter the estimated outbreak spatial pattern. This supports robustness to
all-cause mortality contamination, while not identifying individual deaths by
cause and not proving that pre-outbreak mortality was spatially uniform.

## Parish Population Estimation Method

Main analysis uses per-parish linear interpolation. Two more methods:

1. citywide regression
2. estimate populations using 1624 sestiere population data and 1586 parish shares of sestiere population.

```{r population estimates using sestiere proportion, eval = FALSE}
populations_from_sest <- read.csv("parish_population_estimates_sestiere_proportion.csv") #1624 sestiere populations directly from a census multiplied by parish proportions in that sestiere from 1586 data

colnames(populations_from_sest) <- c("Sestiere", "Parish", "Population_1586", 
                              "Population_1696", "Population_1629_Regression", "Population_1629_Sestiere_Proportion", "Percent_Diff")

populations_from_sest$Parish <- gsub("[[:space:]]", ".", populations_from_sest$Parish)
populations_from_sest$Parish <- sub("^S\\.", "S", populations_from_sest$Parish)

# Remove diacritics
populations_from_sest$Parish <- stri_trans_general(populations_from_sest$Parish, id = "Latin-ASCII")

remove_vec <- c()
```
